units.source_text: “啊，啊，痛，痛啊！痛啊！啊，啊……”他解小手时感到很疼痛。

en.t: “Ah, ah, it hurts, it hurts! It hurts! Ah, ah...” He felt terrible pain when he urinated.

units.source_text: 随着痛苦的喊声，夜壶底响起了小溪似的流水声。

en.t: Along with his cries of pain, the sound of water flowing like a little stream echoed from the bottom of the chamber pot.
